OD-B18-S01-T01.line: Peace, friend. This threshold is wide enough for two hungry men.
OD-B18-S01-T01.direction: shifts aside but keeps his seat

OD-B18-S01-T02.line: Bark all you like, big belly. I have taken no crust out of your mouth yet.
OD-B18-S01-T02.direction: rises slowly as the suitors crowd in

OD-B18-S01-T03.line: Goat bellies are sizzling on our fire, friends. The winner takes the fattest and eats with us from this night on. The loser begs at no door of ours again.
OD-B18-S01-T03.direction: lifts a blood pudding from the coals

OD-B18-S01-T04.line: Swear to me first that no hand in this hall strikes me from behind. An old man cannot fight one belly and a whole house at once.
OD-B18-S01-T04.direction: turns full circle, waiting for the oath

OD-B18-S02-T01.line: Look, then. The rags come up, and you may all see what the sea left me.
OD-B18-S02-T01.direction: belts his rags high, bares thigh and shoulder

OD-B18-S02-T02.line: Stand taller, man of many turns. Let them see the shoulders I remember.
OD-B18-S02-T02.direction: unseen, breathes size into his limbs

OD-B18-S02-T03.line: This one is old. I said he was old. Let me go.
OD-B18-S02-T03.direction: shakes, is dragged into the ring

OD-B18-S02-T04.direction: checks the killing blow, strikes once below the ear

OD-B18-S02-T05.line: Sit there in the dirt and keep the dogs and the pigs off yourself. You were king of the beggars an hour ago. Come back to this gate and you will not walk away from it.
OD-B18-S02-T05.direction: props him against the courtyard gate

OD-B18-S02-T06.line: The suitors laugh until the rafters take it up, and Amphinomus sets bread and a golden cup before the victor. Good fortune to you hereafter, stranger, he says. He does not know what he is wishing on himself.
OD-B18-S02-T06.direction: steps forward as the hall roars

OD-B18-S03-T01.line: Amphinomus, of all these men you seem to carry sense, so hear me. Earth breeds nothing feebler than a man, and no man should walk lawless because the season is kind to him.
OD-B18-S03-T01.direction: raises the cup to him, holds his eye

OD-B18-S03-T02.line: The master of this house is nearer than any of you believe. I pray some god carries you home before he crosses his own threshold, for when he comes there will be blood between him and these suitors.
OD-B18-S03-T02.direction: sets the cup down, does not look away

OD-B18-S03-T03.line: May it be as you say, old man.
OD-B18-S03-T03.direction: walks back to his seat, head down

OD-B18-S03-T04.line: He goes shaking, and he does not go home. Athena has already bound him to this hall, and the spear of Telemachus is waiting for him. That is the third door held open before the killing, and the third man who will not walk through it.
OD-B18-S03-T04.direction: watches him return to the benches

OD-B18-S04-T01.line: Go down among them, Penelope, and shine. Let their knees go weak and their hands go to their treasure chests.
OD-B18-S04-T01.direction: stands unseen at the queen's door

OD-B18-S04-T02.line: Sleep now, daughter of Icarius. I will make you taller than you were and whiter than cut ivory, and wake you at the right moment.
OD-B18-S04-T02.direction: pours sleep and beauty over her

OD-B18-S04-T03.line: Telemachus, your mind was steadier when you were a boy. You let a guest be mauled under this roof, and the shame of it lies on us, not on him.
OD-B18-S04-T03.direction: descends with two maids, veil held at her cheek

OD-B18-S04-T04.line: When Odysseus left me he took my wrist and said, when the boy's beard shows, marry whom you will. That day has come. But what suitors are you, who eat another man's cattle and bring the bride nothing?
OD-B18-S04-T04.direction: stands at the pillar, addresses them all

OD-B18-S04-T05.line: The heralds run, and back come robes and earrings and chains of worked gold. In the shadow by the door Odysseus is smiling, because she is stripping them of their wealth while her heart is somewhere else entirely.

OD-B18-S05-T01.line: I go up. Let the house be lit.
OD-B18-S05-T01.direction: climbs the stair as the maids kindle braziers

OD-B18-S05-T02.line: Still here, stranger? Go sleep in a smithy or a tavern, and stop blinking at your betters by our own fire.
OD-B18-S05-T02.direction: leans over him with a torch

OD-B18-S05-T03.line: Eurymachus, he threatens us with his master's homecoming. The poor thing has had one cup of wine and now he is a prophet.

OD-B18-S05-T04.line: Stranger, that skull of yours burns brighter than the lamps, and not one hair on it. Come work my fields for wages, and see whether you can lift a stone. Or is begging the only trade that fills a belly without sweat?
OD-B18-S05-T04.direction: plays to the laughter of the hall

OD-B18-S05-T05.line: Set the two of us in deep meadow grass in spring with good scythes, and you would not see my back all day. Put us both in the front rank with spears and shields, and no one here would laugh at my bald head.

OD-B18-S05-T06.direction: hurls a footstool, misses, strikes the wine-server

OD-B18-S05-T07.line: Enough. You are full of meat and wine and you are past your own sense. I drive no man out, but this night is over. Go home to your beds.
OD-B18-S05-T07.direction: steps between them, holds the floor

OD-B19-S01-T01.line: Every spear and every shield goes out of this hall tonight, and quietly. If they ask, the smoke has eaten them. The iron itself draws a man on.
OD-B19-S01-T01.direction: speaks low with the doors shut

OD-B19-S01-T02.line: Carry on. The light is mine.
OD-B19-S01-T02.direction: lifts a golden lamp before father and son

OD-B19-S01-T03.line: Nurse, keep the women shut in their rooms until this is done. The smoke has ruined the bronze my father left. And when men are deep in wine I will not have a blade within reach of a quarrel.
OD-B19-S01-T03.direction: carries helmets past her toward the storeroom

OD-B19-S01-T04.line: The walls stand bare where the bronze hung for twenty years. The hall is stripped and swept and ready, and no man who will die in it knows what it has been made ready for.
OD-B19-S01-T04.direction: stands alone in the emptied hall

OD-B19-S02-T01.line: Bold creature, I hear you, and you will pay for it with your own head. I ordered this guest kept by my hearth, and I will question him myself.
OD-B19-S02-T01.direction: comes down to the hearth, dismisses the maid

OD-B19-S02-T02.line: Tell me now, stranger, who you are and from what people. Every man on earth has a father and a city, and I will hear yours.
OD-B19-S02-T02.direction: takes the inlaid chair, faces him

OD-B19-S02-T03.line: Three years I wove a great shroud for old Laertes by day and unpicked it again by torchlight, and they never saw it. Then a maid of mine sold me to them, and the fourth year took the last of my cunning.
OD-B19-S02-T03.direction: sits by the fire, hands empty in her lap

OD-B19-S02-T04.line: You say you gave my husband bread. Then tell me what he wore and what men stood beside him. I have buried too many lies to take another one on trust.

OD-B19-S03-T01.line: In Crete they called me Aethon, third son of Deucalion, of the line of Minos. Your husband was driven to my shore by a north wind, and I gave him bread and dark wine for twelve days.
OD-B19-S03-T01.direction: keeps his voice level and his eyes dry

OD-B19-S03-T02.line: He wore a purple cloak of double fold, pinned with a golden brooch: a hound holding a dappled fawn in its forepaws, the fawn struggling, both of them worked in gold. His tunic shone like the skin of a dried onion. His herald was Eurybates, round in the shoulders, dark, with curling hair, and your husband honored him above every other man.
OD-B19-S03-T02.direction: counts each detail off on his fingers

OD-B19-S03-T03.line: I gave him that brooch with my own hands.
OD-B19-S03-T03.direction: weeps; her face runs like thawing snow

OD-B19-S03-T04.line: Stranger, you were pitied in this house an hour ago. Now you will be loved in it and honored. Those were my gifts, folded by me, and no living man could have known them who had not stood beside him.
OD-B19-S03-T04.direction: rises, steadies herself on the chair

OD-B19-S03-T05.line: You swear to me he is near, and comes before this moon is dead. Then hear my own oath, stranger. If he crosses that threshold, no one alive will ever call you beggar again.
OD-B19-S03-T05.direction: swears with her hand on the chair-back

OD-B19-S04-T01.line: Eurycleia, rise and wash the feet of your master's age-mate. By now the hands and feet of Odysseus must be worn as this man's are, if he is still under the sun.
OD-B19-S04-T01.direction: signals for the basin and warm water

OD-B19-S04-T02.line: Let it be done here, away from the fire.
OD-B19-S04-T02.direction: turns into the shadow, shifts his scarred leg

OD-B19-S04-T03.line: She takes the leg into her old hands, and her palm finds the long white ridge above the knee. The basin tips. Twenty years come back to her through one seam of skin.
OD-B19-S04-T03.direction: moves in close to the basin

OD-B19-S04-T04.line: Odysseus. It is you, dear child, and I did not know my own king until I touched him.
OD-B19-S04-T04.direction: the foot slips, water floods the floor, she turns toward Penelope

OD-B19-S04-T05.line: Nurse, would you destroy me? You fed me at your own breast, and now you will be silent, or when the gods put this house back in my hands I will not spare even you.
OD-B19-S04-T05.direction: seizes her throat, draws her close, whispers

OD-B19-S05-T01.line: That scar is older than Troy. It was cut on the day the boy Odysseus climbed to the house of Autolycus, his mother's father, who had named him and promised him gifts.
OD-B19-S05-T01.direction: steps out of the hall into memory

OD-B19-S05-T02.line: At first light they go out with the hounds, the sons of Autolycus and the boy among them, up the wooded flanks of Parnassus. The sun is just striking the folds of the mountain.
OD-B19-S05-T02.direction: walks the slope with the hunters

OD-B19-S05-T03.line: In a thicket so dense no wet wind ever entered it, the boar is lying. It hears the feet and the dogs, and it comes out with its bristles up and fire standing in its eyes.

OD-B19-S05-T04.direction: drives the spear through its shoulder as the tusk rips above his knee

OD-B19-S05-T05.line: The sons of Autolycus bind the wound with skill and stop the dark blood with a chanted charm. They carry the boy down to the house, heal him, and send him home to Ithaca loaded with gifts. He carried the mark of it into every year that followed.
OD-B19-S05-T05.direction: closes the memory, returns to the hall

OD-B19-S06-T01.line: Hear my dream, stranger, and tell me what it means. Twenty geese feed at my trough and I love to watch them. Then a great eagle stoops from the mountain and breaks the neck of every one.
OD-B19-S06-T01.direction: sits again beside him, quieter now

OD-B19-S06-T02.line: Then the eagle comes back and speaks with a man's voice, and the voice is his. Take heart, it says. This is no dream but a waking thing that will be done. The geese are the suitors, and I am your husband, come home.
OD-B19-S06-T02.direction: speaks the eagle's words into the room

OD-B19-S06-T03.line: There is no second reading of it, lady. The dream has told you its own meaning, and it has named the day of their death.

OD-B19-S06-T04.line: Tomorrow I will set out the great bow of Odysseus and the twelve axes he used to line up and shoot an arrow through. Whoever strings that bow and sends the shaft clean through them all, that man I will follow. And I will leave this house that I loved.
OD-B19-S06-T04.direction: declares it to the empty hall

OD-B19-S06-T05.line: Dreams come through two gates, stranger: one of horn that comes true, one of ivory that lies to us. I think mine came the wrong way. Good night to you.
OD-B19-S06-T05.direction: climbs to her room; Athena closes her eyes
